mainText: Argentina passed a bill that loosens protection of its glaciers.
Greece plans to implement a ban on social media access for individuals under 15 years old beginning next year.
At least 182 people killed across Lebanon in Israeli strikes.
President Trump stated Israeli strikes on Lebanon are a 'separate skirmish' not part of an Iran ceasefire.
Oil prices fell below $95 per barrel and the Dow Jones Industrial Average increased approximately 1,100 points following an Iran ceasefire agreement.
